faq.q: Who releases the PMI data for India?
faq.a: For India, the PMI data is compiled and released by S&P Global, based on surveys conducted by HSBC Bank.

faq.q: How often is the PMI released?
faq.a: The PMI data is usually released monthly, providing a timely update on economic activity.
"Flash" PMI is a preliminary estimate released earlier than the final data. It's based on about 80-90% of the survey responses and gives a quick, early indication of the month's performance.
